correctness.rationale: Writing the two-fiber operation as (i,x)*(j,y)=(i,A_ij x+B_ij y), with B=1-F, gives the exact self-distributivity equations B_ij(A_ik-A_jk)=0 and B_ik(1-A_ij)=B_ij B_jk. With A_00=A_11=2 and B_00=B_11=-1, the off-diagonal variables u=B_01 and v=B_10 have exactly two branches under the unit-coefficient hypotheses: u=v=0 with A_01=A_10=1, or A_01=A_10=2 and uv=1. Thus r=u ranges through nonzero r not equal to 1, giving F_01=1-r and F_10=1-r^{-1}; r=-1 is the printed all-2 case and the other p-3 choices are omitted. A fresh exhaustive finite-field replay for p=5,7,11 found exactly the predicted p-1 total solutions (the decoupled point plus p-2 coupled points), supporting the algebraic derivation without replacing it.
